gloss: core, crux, heart of a matter

definitions.gloss: core, crux, heart of a matter
definitions.explanation: The most important or central point of an issue, problem, or argument. Used when referring to the essential part that everything else revolves around.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{核心|かくしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧。
examples.english: To touch on the crux of the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{核心|かくしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}いていた→突く：12735_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: His remarks hit the heart of the matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長引|ながび}いている→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦そろそろ→そろそろ：01259_sorosoro⟧{核心|かくしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: The discussion has been dragging on, but it's time we got to the heart of the matter.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {核心|かくしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|ふ}れる→触れる：01984_fureru⟧: to touch on the core issue
- {核心|かくしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}く→突く：12735_tsuku⟧: to hit the nail on the head
- {核心|かくしん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧: to get to the heart of the matter
- {核心|かくしん}⟦{部分|ぶぶん}→部分：03715_bubun⟧: the core part

SIMILAR WORDS:
{核心|かくしん} focuses on the most critical point of an argument or issue. ⟦{要点|ようてん}→要点：01668_youten⟧ (key point) is broader and more neutral, while {核心|かくしん} emphasizes the idea of penetrating to the essential center.
